source.text: Simon Rumley( born 22 May 1968) is a British screenwriter, director and author. Mostly associated with the horror genre, he was described by" Screen International" as" one of the great British cinematic outsiders, a gifted director with the know- how to puncture the conventions". He has won several awards and worked with, among others, Roger Lloyd- Pack, Greta Scacchi, Noah Taylor and Peter Facinelli.

benchmark supervision.
